displayAddress: Western Harbour Terrace, Edinburgh, Midlothian, EH6
description:
Western Harbour offers modern living with double glazing throughout, secure phone entry system, lifts to all floors and a private and secure underground car parking space allocated to it. The property sits within a fully factored building which means all communal areas, both internally and externally are well maintained. 

This is a beautifully spacious three bedroom apartment with a private balcony enjoying views of the Edinburgh skyline and the Forth. The property has been thoughtfully designed to create a stylish home of space and enviable modern living. and is set in a modern, factored, and lift-served apartment block, located in popular Newhaven, to the north of Edinburgh city centre. 

Accommodation comprises: large entrance hallway, lounge with balcony off, three bedrooms one with en suite shower room, well fitted kitchen with and bathroom. Presented to the market in true move-in condition, the light tasteful décor is complemented attractive fitted floor coverings. Comfort is further assured by means of gas central heating complemented by the installation of double glazed windows and the property also benefits from excellent storage. A entry phone system provides security to the mutual stairway with lift access to all floors. Attractive communal landscaped gardens and secure underground parking area with dedicated car parking space.

Situation

Western Harbour Terrace is situated in the popular Newhaven area of Edinburgh to the north of Edinburgh's city centre. The area is home to the Scottish Government and the Royal Yacht Britannia. It's unique waterfront setting has been revitalised in recent years, now providing an exciting mix of traditional businesses and cutting-edge enterprises, peppered with luxury modern developments, and many of the original Victorian buildings and warehouses have been sympathetically converted leaving a vibrant cosmopolitan area. It is home to many of the city's top restaurants ranging from traditional-style seafood menus to contemporary cafés and eateries. There are many pubs and bars along the waterfront, from cosy Scottish pubs to popular style bars. Western Harbour Terrace also has easy access to all the facilities in Ocean Terminal, where there is a range of quality restaurants and bars and a multiplex cinema complex. There is also a David Lloyd Gym within striking distance. Western Harbour Terrace has a bus stop located directly across the road offering a number of convenient transport links throughout the city centre as well as an airport bus link. There are a number of reputable state schools within the catchment area as well as convenient access to private schools.
